description: Freelance software developer and web engineer, specialized in front-end web development and passionate about software engineering in general.
AboutMeText1: I am a full-stack web engineer and software developer, with a Master’s degree in Computer Science from the University of Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina.
AboutMeText2: Computers became my passion in the late 90s, when I got my first PC. I have spent most of my life in front of a screen ever since: gaming in the early years, then blogging, learning and working in web design and development.
AboutMeText3: These days I work across the whole web stack, and JavaScript and the front end are where I feel most at home.
